title: Offer Two Choices, Skip the Standoff
caption:
"Brush your hair now!" invites a no. "Hair before breakfast or after?" invites an answer.

Both choices end with brushed hair. They just pick the order.
It only works if we truly mean both options.

Save this and try one tomorrow.
